info.name: interplant-ogc
info.description:
INTERPLANT OGC API (pygeoapi 0.23.4).

{{url}} MUST include the /ogc path prefix - the service runs with SCRIPT_NAME=/ogc
and rejects any request that does not start with it.

  via SSH tunnel : http://localhost:8801/ogc
  public         : https://www.plabipd.de/ogc   (live since 2026-09-15)

Switching between them changes only scheme+host; every path here is unchanged.

Response `links` advertise the public base URL, which is now live, so rel=next can be
followed directly. Through the tunnel, followed links still leave the tunnel.

Folder 06 pins limitations of pygeoapi 0.23.4 that we cannot fix. The q= entry is a
TRAP - read its description before trusting any search result from this API.

variable.description: Public since 2026-09-15. Must include /ogc. For the tunnel use http://localhost:8801/ogc.
